summary: BioVie Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a best-efforts registered direct offering of 960,000 Class A common shares at $1.60 per share and 2,002,500 pre-funded warrants at $1.5999 each (exercise price $0.0001), plus an unregistered concurrent private placement of 2,962,500 common warrants at $1.70 exercisable in six months and expiring five years later. Gross proceeds total roughly $4.74 million, with A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners as exclusive placement agent earning a 7.0% cash fee; net proceeds about $4.41 million. This is a routine equity capital raise, not a special situation; watch dilution and warrant overhang.
